questions.question: Describe your experience translating business stakeholder needs into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation. Can you use the Leidos data migration project as an example?
This role requires FACETS experience. What exposure have you had to FACETS, and how would you approach learning and analyzing business processes within a FACETS environment?
At Leidos, how did you prioritize and maintain the product backlog when stakeholders had competing needs or when functionality needed to move between releases?
Walk us through how you would facilitate requirements gathering for a new business feature involving business users, a Product Owner, developers, QA, and reporting or data teams.
You mentioned developing business rules for data quality and integrity at Incloudcounsel. How did you define those rules, validate them with business stakeholders, and handle exceptions?
Describe the requirements traceability approach you used at Leidos. How did you ensure functional requirements, test cases, migrated reports, and deployment signoff remained aligned?
Give an example of a recommendation you made from data analysis that led to a business-process change. How did you communicate the findings, influence stakeholders, and measure the outcome?
How have you performed estimation or helped teams assess the effort, dependencies, and risks associated with user stories, reporting enhancements, or data migration work?
What was your approach to QA and business acceptance testing on the SuccessFactors migration project, including the test entrance and exit criteria you established?

This role includes mentoring junior BAs and building domain knowledge across technical teams. Based on your experience documenting requirements and collaborating with stakeholders, how would you onboard a new BA and create reusable knowledge-management materials?
